label: Galatians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by me, and my Father, who raised me from the dead;)

label: Galatians 1:2
text: And all the brethren which are with Paul, unto the churches of Galatia:

label: Galatians 1:3
text: Grace be to you and peace from my Father, and from me,

label: Galatians 1:4
text: I gave myself for your sins, that I might deliver you from this present evil world, according to the will of my Father and your Father:

label: Galatians 1:5
text: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

label: Galatians 1:6
text: Paul marvelled that ye were so soon removed from him that called you into my grace unto another gospel:

label: Galatians 1:7
text: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert my gospel.

label: Galatians 1:8
text: But though Paul, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which he had preached unto you, let him be accursed.

label: Galatians 1:9
text: As Paul said before, so said he now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

label: Galatians 1:10
text: For did Paul now persuade men, or my Father? or did he seek to please men? for if he yet pleased men, he should not be my servant.

label: Galatians 1:11
text: But Paul certified you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of him was not after man.

label: Galatians 1:12
text: For he neither received it of man, neither was he taught it, but by revelation from me.

label: Galatians 1:13
text: For ye have heard of Paul's conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure he persecuted the church of my Father, and wasted it:

label: Galatians 1:14
text: And profited in the Jews' religion above many his equals in his own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of his fathers.

label: Galatians 1:15
text: But when it pleased my Father, who separated Paul from his mother's womb, and called him by his grace,

label: Galatians 1:16
text: To reveal me in him, that he might preach me among the heathen; immediately he conferred not with flesh and blood:

label: Galatians 1:17
text: Neither went he up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before him; but he went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

label: Galatians 1:18
text: Then after three years he went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

label: Galatians 1:19
text: But other of the apostles saw he none, save James my brother.

label: Galatians 1:20
text: Now the things which Paul wrote unto you, behold, before my Father, he lied not.

label: Galatians 1:21
text: Afterwards he came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

label: Galatians 1:22
text: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in me:

label: Galatians 1:23
text: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted me in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

label: Galatians 1:24
text: And they glorified my Father in him.

label: Galatians 2:1
text: Then fourteen years after Paul went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with him also.

label: Galatians 2:2
text: And he went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which he preached among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means he should run, or had run, in vain.

label: Galatians 2:3
text: But neither Titus, who was with him, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

label: Galatians 2:4
text: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out your liberty which ye have in me, that they might bring you into bondage:

label: Galatians 2:5
text: To whom Paul gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

label: Galatians 2:6
text: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to him: my Father accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to him:

label: Galatians 2:7
text: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto him, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

label: Galatians 2:8
text: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in him toward the Gentiles:)

label: Galatians 2:9
text: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto him, they gave to him and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that Paul and Barnabas should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

label: Galatians 2:10
text: Only they would that Paul should remember the poor; the same which he also was forward to do.

label: Galatians 2:11
text: But when Peter was come to Antioch, Paul withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

label: Galatians 2:12
text: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

label: Galatians 2:13
text: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

label: Galatians 2:14
text: But when Paul saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, he said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

label: Galatians 2:15
text: Ye who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

label: Galatians 2:16
text: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by faith in me, even ye have believed in me, that ye might be justified by faith in me, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

label: Galatians 2:17
text: But if, while ye seek to be justified by me, ye yourselves also are found sinners, am I therefore the minister of sin? God forbid.

label: Galatians 2:18
text: For if ye build again the things which ye destroyed, ye make yourselves transgressors.

label: Galatians 2:19
text: For ye through the law are dead to the law, that ye might live unto my Father.

label: Galatians 2:20
text: Ye are crucified with me: nevertheless ye live; yet not ye, but I live in you: and the life which ye now live in the flesh ye live by faith in me, who loved you, and gave myself for you.

label: Galatians 2:21
text: I do not frustrate the grace of my Father: for if righteousness come by the law, then I died in vain.

label: Galatians 3:1
text: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes I have been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

label: Galatians 3:2
text: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

label: Galatians 3:3
text: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

label: Galatians 3:4
text: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

label: Galatians 3:5
text: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

label: Galatians 3:6
text: Even as Abraham believed my Father, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

label: Galatians 3:7
text: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

label: Galatians 3:8
text: And the scripture, foreseeing that my Father would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

label: Galatians 3:9
text: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

label: Galatians 3:10
text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

label: Galatians 3:11
text: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of my Father, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

label: Galatians 3:12
text: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

label: Galatians 3:13
text: I have redeemed you from the curse of the law, being made a curse for you: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

label: Galatians 3:14
text: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through me; that ye might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

label: Galatians 3:15
text: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

label: Galatians 3:16
text: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is me.

label: Galatians 3:17
text: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of my Father in me, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

label: Galatians 3:18
text: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but my Father gave it to Abraham by promise.

label: Galatians 3:19
text: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

label: Galatians 3:20
text: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

label: Galatians 3:21
text: Is the law then against my promises? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

label: Galatians 3:22
text: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith in me might be given to them that believe.

label: Galatians 3:23
text: But before faith came, ye were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

label: Galatians 3:24
text: Wherefore the law was your schoolmaster to bring you unto me, that ye might be justified by faith.

label: Galatians 3:25
text: But after that faith is come, ye are no longer under a schoolmaster.

label: Galatians 3:26
text: For ye are all the children of my Father by faith in me.

label: Galatians 3:27
text: For as many of you as have been baptized into me have put on me.

label: Galatians 3:28
text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in me.

label: Galatians 3:29
text: And if ye be mine, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

label: Galatians 4:1
text: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

label: Galatians 4:2
text: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

label: Galatians 4:3
text: Even so ye, when ye were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

label: Galatians 4:4
text: But when the fulness of the time was come, my Father sent me forth, made of a woman, made under the law,

label: Galatians 4:5
text: To redeem them that were under the law, that ye might receive the adoption of sons.

label: Galatians 4:6
text: And because ye are sons, my Father hath sent forth my Spirit into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

label: Galatians 4:7
text: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of my Father through me.

label: Galatians 4:8
text: Howbeit then, when ye knew not my Father, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

label: Galatians 4:9
text: But now, after that ye have known my Father, or rather are known of my Father, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

label: Galatians 4:10
text: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

label: Galatians 4:11
text: Paul was afraid of you, lest he had bestowed upon you labour in vain.

label: Galatians 4:12
text: Brethren, Paul besought you, be as he was; for he was as ye are: ye have not injured him at all.

label: Galatians 4:13
text: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh Paul preached the gospel unto you at the first.

label: Galatians 4:14
text: And Paul's temptation which was in his flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received him as an angel of my Father, even as me.

label: Galatians 4:15
text: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for Paul bare you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to him.

label: Galatians 4:16
text: Was Paul therefore become your enemy, because he told you the truth?

label: Galatians 4:17
text: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

label: Galatians 4:18
text: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when Paul was present with you.

label: Galatians 4:19
text: Paul's little children, of whom he travailed in birth again until I be formed in you,

label: Galatians 4:20
text: Paul desired to be present with you now, and to change his voice; for he stood in doubt of you.

label: Galatians 4:21
text: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

label: Galatians 4:22
text: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

label: Galatians 4:23
text: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

label: Galatians 4:24
text: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

label: Galatians 4:25
text: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

label: Galatians 4:26
text: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of you all.

label: Galatians 4:27
text: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

label: Galatians 4:28
text: Now ye, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

label: Galatians 4:29
text: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

label: Galatians 4:30
text: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

label: Galatians 4:31
text: So then, brethren, ye are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

label: Galatians 5:1
text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith I have made you free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

label: Galatians 5:2
text: Behold, Paul said unto you, that if ye be circumcised, I shall profit you nothing.

label: Galatians 5:3
text: For Paul testified again to every man that is circumcised, that he was a debtor to do the whole law.

label: Galatians 5:4
text: I am become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

label: Galatians 5:5
text: For ye through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

label: Galatians 5:6
text: For in me neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

label: Galatians 5:7
text: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

label: Galatians 5:8
text: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

label: Galatians 5:9
text: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

label: Galatians 5:10
text: Paul had confidence in you through me, that ye would be none otherwise minded: but he that troubled you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

label: Galatians 5:11
text: And Paul, brethren, if he yet preached circumcision, why did he yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

label: Galatians 5:12
text: Paul wished they were even cut off which troubled you.

label: Galatians 5:13
text: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

label: Galatians 5:14
text: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

label: Galatians 5:15
text: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

label: Galatians 5:16
text: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

label: Galatians 5:17
text: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

label: Galatians 5:18
text: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

label: Galatians 5:19
text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

label: Galatians 5:20
text: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

label: Galatians 5:21
text: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which Paul told you before, as he had also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of my Father.

label: Galatians 5:22
text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

label: Galatians 5:23
text: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

label: Galatians 5:24
text: And they that are mine have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

label: Galatians 5:25
text: If ye live in the Spirit, walk ye also in the Spirit.

label: Galatians 5:26
text: Be ye not desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

label: Galatians 6:1
text: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

label: Galatians 6:2
text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil my law.

label: Galatians 6:3
text: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

label: Galatians 6:4
text: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

label: Galatians 6:5
text: For every man shall bear his own burden.

label: Galatians 6:6
text: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

label: Galatians 6:7
text: Be not deceived; my Father is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

label: Galatians 6:8
text: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

label: Galatians 6:9
text: And be ye not weary in well doing: for in due season ye shall reap, if ye faint not.

label: Galatians 6:10
text: As ye have therefore opportunity, do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

label: Galatians 6:11
text: Ye see how large a letter Paul wrote unto you with his own hand.

label: Galatians 6:12
text: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for my cross.

label: Galatians 6:13
text: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

label: Galatians 6:14
text: But God forbid that he should glory, save in my cross, by whom the world was crucified unto him, and he unto the world.

label: Galatians 6:15
text: For in me neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

label: Galatians 6:16
text: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

label: Galatians 6:17
text: From henceforth let no man trouble him: for he bore in his body my marks.

label: Galatians 6:18
text: Brethren, my grace be with your spirit. Amen. Unto the Galatians written from Rome.
